passage:
A museum became crowded after a popular online video recommended it. Visitors lined up for one famous room and ignored quieter exhibits.
The museum was happy about attention but worried about damage and poor visitor experience. It introduced timed entry and guided routes to spread people out.
Students discussed how social media can change real places quickly.
A post can bring income and recognition, but also pressure. Places designed for slow looking may struggle with sudden crowds chasing photos.
The museum learned that popularity needs management. Being seen online is not the same as being understood in person.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A museum became crowded after a popular online video recommended it.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Digital Museum Crowd: A museum became crowded after a popular online video recommended it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Digital Museum Guide」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Digital Concert Hall」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The News Before Breakfast」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
